```{=html}
<style>
.ar-demo{margin:1rem 0 1.8rem;padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--site-surface)}
.ar-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.ar-tools .btn{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8rem}
.ar-parts{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem}
.ar-lbl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:0 .2rem 0 .5rem}
.ar-on,.ar-tools .btn.ar-on,.ao-seg .btn.ar-on,.ao-row .btn.ar-on{background:var(--site-accent-dk);border-color:var(--site-accent-dk);color:#fff}
.ar-chip:not(.ar-on){text-decoration:line-through;opacity:.75}
.ar-staff{min-height:3rem;overflow-x:auto}
.ar-hint,.ao-hint{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--site-ink-2);margin:.3rem 0}
.ar-organ{margin:1rem 0 1.8rem;padding:1rem;border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--site-surface)}
.ao-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-end}
.ao-bars{display:flex;gap:.35rem;padding:.6rem;border-radius:6px;background:#2a2420}
.ao-bar{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:2.1rem}
.ao-bar input{writing-mode:vertical-lr;direction:rtl;height:9rem;width:1.6rem;margin:.2rem 0}
.ao-brown input{accent-color:#8a4b2a}.ao-white input{accent-color:#e8e2d6}.ao-black input{accent-color:#111}
.ao-num{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.9rem;color:#f5efe2}
.ao-feet{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.68rem;color:#d8cfc0}
.ao-spec{flex:1 1 300px;min-width:240px}
.ao-spec svg{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:11rem}
.ao-grid{stroke:var(--site-border);stroke-width:1}
.ao-ax{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:8px;fill:var(--site-ink-2);text-anchor:middle}
.ao-line{stroke-width:5;stroke-linecap:round}
.ao-lbrown{stroke:#8a4b2a}.ao-lwhite{stroke:var(--site-accent-dk)}.ao-lblack{stroke:#333}
.ao-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin:.6rem 0}
.ao-reg{max-width:22rem}
.ao-what{margin:.2rem 0 .6rem;font-size:.9rem;min-height:1.2em}
.ao-keys{display:flex;position:relative;height:7rem;margin:.8rem 0;user-select:none;touch-action:none;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto}
.ao-key{border:1px solid #555;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
.ao-wht{flex:0 0 2.2rem;height:100%;background:#fff;z-index:1}
.ao-blk{flex:0 0 1.4rem;height:62%;margin:0 -.7rem;background:#222;z-index:2}
.ao-key.ao-down{background:var(--site-accent)}
.ao-ctl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(15rem,1fr));gap:.8rem}
.ao-group{border:1px solid var(--site-border);border-radius:6px;padding:.4rem .8rem .6rem}
.ao-group legend{float:none;width:auto;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:600;padding:0 .3rem;margin:0}
.ao-seg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.3rem;margin:.3rem 0}
.ao-seg .btn{font-size:.8rem}
.ao-auto{font-size:.82rem;display:block;margin:.3rem 0}
.ao-ends{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
.ao-base{fill:#555}.ao-shoe{fill:#333}.ao-pivot{fill:#999}
.ao-cab{fill:#6b4a2f;stroke:#3e2a1a}.ao-ring{fill:none;stroke:#c8b89a;stroke-dasharray:3 3}
.ao-hornp{fill:#e8e2d6}.ao-dummy{fill:#a89a80}.ao-drump{fill:#c8b89a;opacity:.85}.ao-hub{fill:#222}
.ao-rotor .ao-ax{fill:#f5efe2}
.ao-rpm{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--site-ink-2)}
#ar-bar label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--parch-dim);margin-right:.3rem}
#ar-bar input[type=number]{width:4.2rem;font-size:.85rem;padding:.15rem .3rem;border:1px solid var(--parch-edge);border-radius:4px;background:#fff}
#ar-bar input[type=range]{width:7rem;vertical-align:middle}
#ar-status{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.75rem;color:var(--parch-dim);width:11rem;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
</style>
<div id="ar-bar">
  <span data-pri="1"><label for="ar-tempo">Tempo</label><input type="range" id="ar-tempo" min="40" max="220" step="2"> <input type="number" id="ar-tempo-n" min="40" max="220" step="2" aria-label="Tempo in beats per minute"></span>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="ar-stop" disabled>■ Stop</button>
  <span id="ar-status" aria-live="polite" data-pri="2"></span>
</div>
```
